headline: Pangenome and haplotype-resolved references reshape genome and population analysis
label: Pangenome Scale Genome Analysis
summary: Large phased assemblies, pangenome-based patching and updated population statistics make haplotype-aware resources central to genome analysis.
synthesis: The dominant thread is a move from single linear references toward pangenome and phased-haplotype resources. A release of 320 near-complete, phased East Asian assemblies from 160 individuals reports novel sequences, gene gains, structural variants and inversions. ImpuT2T uses a T2T pangenome panel to scaffold and patch gaps in inexpensive HiFi human assemblies and outperforms existing patching approaches. Gnomix with Gnofix provides local ancestry inference with improved accuracy and speed and portable, shareable models. The pixy update adds missing-data-unbiased Watterson's theta and Tajima's D, with arbitrary ploidy and multiallelic support. simPIC addresses evaluation rather than haplotype resolution: it simulates single-cell ATAC-seq paired-insertion counts across individuals and populations with known ground truth. What is new is haplotype-resolved data feeding assembly, ancestry and population statistics, with simulation supplying ground truth for method evaluation.
